title: AI runs, triage and task logs on jobs (P60.2)
extra:
Epic 1.0.0 of easy-review (repo VilfredSikker/easy-review), release branch release/v1.0.0. Plans: docs/epics/1.0.0/PLAN.md, ADDENDUM-06-phase-5.md (desktop protocol), ADDENDUM-07-phase-5b.md (TUI). Read the merged PR bodies of earlier items and the item issue's comments for deviations and coordinator decisions. Heavy checks run one at a time, sandbox off, through ~/.claude/scripts/epic-run.sh <dir> ~/.claude/scripts/locked.sh <dir> just <gate>, under a temp HOME; afterwards the temp HOME must hold no Library/Application Support/easy-review/v1/app. desktop-ui gates (lint-ui, test-ui, check-ui with one known error in src/main.ts) need desktop-ui/node_modules symlinked and bun on PATH: /Users/vilfredsikker/.local/share/mise/installs/bun/1.4.4/bin first, via a scratch script run as epic-run.sh <dir> bash <script>. Stop line 1,500 counted lines per PR (added plus changed after rename detection). Known flaky test projects::tests::a_pin_landing_during_a_desktop_update_survives (#630): name it if it fails, never change it. Never rebase or force-push. Commit with plain git outside epic-run.sh (its temp HOME can drop the signature silently); if signing fails, retry twice over two minutes; if it still fails, follow the RULES fallback (commit unsigned, say so in the PR body) and report it. Push with the sandbox off, written exactly: cd <dir> && git push origin <branch>. gh with the sandbox off, one command per call. Never read or write ~/Library/Application Support/easy-review. Post questions on the item issue and return status "decision" if blocked; do not SendMessage the coordinator. Owner go-ahead: on 2026-11-22 the owner set the goal "implement phase 5 fully"; the coordinator runs the remaining phase-5 items (P56.2 to P62.2) in dependency order.

P60.2 BUILD (phase 5). Merged in release: P56.3 (History, Conflicts and Hidden load in the Workspace), P58.1, P58.2, P59 (#692, #693) and P60.1a (#694 jobs aggregate and the arena context, #695 arena wire commands and jobs.arena_runs, #696 the arena progress feed on jobs). Being built beside you: P60.1b (review flows on jobs, flow_get_run on er_fetch, reconcile_on_load over TabsView) in clone p60b on epic/p60b-review-flows, and P61 (#697, #698, window commands and the export) in clone p61. Keep edits to jobs, shared enums, er-protocol, command lists and generated bindings additive, and regenerate generated files on a merge. Coordinator ruling on #620 (P61): THIS entry removes the tick's check_ai_files_changed and the tick.rs exception in the resources/ scan, because it removes the last other flag-on readers of the App's tab.ai (ask_ai_impl, ask_ai_for_finding, reply_to_finding_impl; reply_to_finding's ai_assist arm is yours per P58.2); P61's export-reload test already passes through ReloadSidecars. Rulings so far are on #612, #614, #615, #616, #618 and #620; read them. Branch from origin/release/v1.0.0 in a new clone /Users/vilfredsikker/.claude-worktrees/er-v1/p60c (git clone --quiet /Users/vilfredsikker/Projects/easy-review <dir>, set origin to https://github.com/VilfredSikker/easy-review.git, fetch). Before building, re-verify the entry's citations against origin/release/v1.0.0 and post corrections on #619. Use the entry's fallback split as stacked PRs if over 1,500. Merge origin/release/v1.0.0 in before opening PRs.
review_focus:
Item P60.2 (#619), phase 5. The ADDENDUM-06 entry is the spec:
### P60.2 AI runs, triage and task logs on `jobs`

- Branch: `epic/p60b-jobs-runs`. Lanes: S, D, DS, U, P. Model: `opus`. Depends on: P60.1, P59 (the chain runs `{ P59 ∥ P60.1 } → P60.2`), P56.3 (the prompt-context parity fixture shows a plain local tab in History, which `load_tab` refuses until P56.3 loads it, `er-service/src/effect.rs:220`–`:228`), P55.3 (DS is free once the sidebar track ends).
- **Goal:** card AI, review runs, triage and the background task panel read `jobs`.
- **Done when:** the 19 run, triage and log commands go through `er_send`/`er_fetch`; agent and task output lines are read per job and stay out of `jobs` (A3); triage spinners read `jobs` (owner answer); auto-triage writes its queue through the desktop owner, and `auto_triage.rs` drops its App handle (`AutoTriageCtx.app`, `:17`) and `er_engine::app::BackgroundTaskTarget` (`:11`) for the service's job target, or for a target type moved to the engine's always-compiled half (lane S) if the service has none; `ask_ai` and `validate_with_ai` go through `er_send` and keep their in-flight replies in `jobs` (P58.1); `ask_ai_impl` and `ask_ai_for_finding` stop reading the App: provider, model and effort come from the settings actor's default selection (A18) instead of `current_ai_*` (`commands.rs:5834`, `:5835`, `:5880`, `:5881`, `:5907`, `:6112`, `:6113`, `:6151`), `App::sync_ai_selection` (`:5736`, `:6054`), which rewrites `current_ai_*`, leaves the flag path, and the saved selection is resolved over the settings view as A18 says; the thread and finding lookups come from the tab's AI section (`AiSection.state`) instead of `app.tab().ai` (`:5777`, `:5848`; `finding_id_for_thread` `:6000`, `lookup_finding_fields` `:6022` and `finding_fields_for_ref` `:6275` take `&AiState` in place of `&TabState`); the rest of the prompt context, which both build under the App lock today (`commands.rs:5758`–`:5770`, `:5808`, `:5824`–`:5829`; `:6075`–`:6115`), comes from the tab's content: `repo_root`, `base_branch`, `current_branch` and the mode from its `ResolvedTab` (`TabContent.tab`), `is_remote` and `er_dir`, and so `work_dir`, from its `TabContext`, `files` from its diff section (`DiffSection.files`, `er-service/src/content.rs:233`), with a file the section holds as an unparsed stub parsed through `ParseFiles` first (A4's one bounded wait) so that `ask_ai_for_finding`'s line content (`:6090`–`:6097`) reads its hunks, which differs from today's flag-off answer for a stub nobody has opened, where the App reads the stub's empty hunks and gives no line content, and the agent model fallback (`app.config.agent.model`, `:5836`, `:5882`, `:6114`) from the settings view; the raw diff (`raw_diff_for_review`, `:5765`, `:6084`) comes from a step extracted into er-service (lane S): the content's `DiffMeta.raw` (`content.rs:245`) when the review scope matches what the content fetched, by the rule of `TabState::review_scope_matches_cached_diff` (`crates/er-engine/src/app/state/mod.rs:2786`, a private method that becomes a free function over the tab identity and mode, which the App also calls, reading on the flag path the content's checkout root that `load_tab` sets by the App watcher's rule, P56.1) and the content's `DiffMeta.branch_diff_hash` is non-empty, as `raw_diff_for_review` requires of the App's (`mod.rs:2841`), and otherwise `er_engine::diff_load::fetch_raw` (`crates/er-engine/src/diff_load.rs:170`) off the actor thread, with `committed_unpushed` false, as the service passes it (`effect.rs:315`), where the App passes its Staged view's flag; in History, Conflicts and Hidden the step skips the content's raw and calls `fetch_raw`, which refuses History and Conflicts and answers an empty diff for Hidden (`diff_load.rs:176`–`:181`), so on a remote tab or a local branch view with no checkout root, which the rule matches in every mode (`mod.rs:2787`–`:2792`), the flag-on answer in those three views is `fetch_raw`'s where today's App answers the raw diff it cached in the mode it left; that difference is intended, since the content keeps no diff from the mode it left; the answer lands through the service, where today the spawned threads lock the App to write it (`submit_ai_reply`, `commands.rs:5972`–`:5988`; `append_finding_response` and `reload_ai_state`, `:6209`–`:6218`): two new commands (lane S), `SubmitAiReply`, which writes through the `er_engine::annotations` path `ReplyToThread` uses (`er-service/src/annotations.rs:171`) with `ReplyAttribution { author: "ai", ai_action }` (`crates/er-engine/src/annotations.rs:42`), and `AppendFindingResponse` over `er_engine::ai::append_finding_response` (`crates/er-engine/src/ai/finding_responses.rs:162`); both carry the asking tab's `TabKey` and the `TabContext` captured when the ask starts, go to the actor that owns that key, and write to that context's buckets with no active-tab lookup and no painted-view refusal at landing (they skip `context_matches`, `er-service/src/actor.rs:327`, which compares workspace keys only), and when the asking tab closed before the answer, the command still goes to the actor for the captured context's workspace key, started when none runs, writes to the captured bucket and clears the `jobs` entry, so the answer is there when the tab reopens, where today a thread answer lands on the App's active tab at landing time (`App::submit_ai_reply` writes through `write_annotation` on `tab()`, `crates/er-engine/src/app/state/comments.rs:1014`–`:1034`); the meta-cache refresh after the answer (`:5993`, `:6223`) goes through the sidebar owner (P55.1); with those readers gone, P53's write of the saved selection into the App's `current_ai_*` (`ai_selection_service.rs:30`–`:34`) is deleted and `ai_selection_service.rs` takes `DesktopState`; the `ai_assist` arm of `reply_to_finding` goes through `er_send`: today `FindingReplyRoute::FlagOff` (`commands.rs:10411`–`:10413`) sends it to `reply_to_finding_impl` (`:10437`), which locks the App, reads `app.tab().ai.review` (`:10458`), writes the stub thread on the App (`:10492`) and calls `ask_ai_impl` (`:10522`); the new mapping finds the finding in the tab's AI section, creates the finding thread through the service write P58.2 maps, then runs the ask through the new path with its in-flight reply in `jobs`. **Test change, up front:** `finding_reply_route`'s test (`commands.rs:16448`–`:16455`) asserts that `ai_assist` takes the flag-off route; it changes to assert that both values take the service route, and the `FlagOff` arm goes; the tick's four agent and task duties (`drain_agent_log`, `check_commands`, `poll_background_tasks`, `process_ai_task_inbox`) move off the App with the runs they drive, so the only App duty left on the tick is `check_ai_files_changed`, which P61 removes (A17); the entry stops reading `agent_commands`, `agent_log`, `background_tasks` and `bg_loading`.
- **Planted breaks:** a triage queued without a `jobs` bump leaves the spinner off and fails; an agent or task output line that moves the `jobs` version fails the precision test; an ask whose tab closes before the answer still writes the answer to the captured bucket and clears its `jobs` entry, and a landing that drops it for an unlisted key fails the closed-tab test; a task log fetched from the App fails the source scan; a tick that calls an App duty other than `check_ai_files_changed` fails the same scan; an `er_send` `ask_ai` that skips the in-flight insert shows no pending reply and fails the pending test; with the flag on, `set_ai_selection` then `ask_ai` runs with the new model, and with the App locked it still starts, so an `ask_ai` that reads `current_ai_*` from the App fails the held-App-mutex test; with the App locked, an `ai_assist` reply creates the finding thread and shows its pending reply in `jobs`, and routing it to `reply_to_finding_impl` fails the same test; a cancel that does not reach the runner fails the reused `CancelJob` assertion (P43); with the App locked, a flag-on `ask_ai` and a `validate_with_ai` each start, land their answer through `SubmitAiReply` or `AppendFindingResponse` and clear their pending entry in `jobs`, and an `ask_ai` that calls `sync_ai_selection` or writes its answer on the App times out and fails that test; the prompt-context parity test compares the flag-on context with the flag-off one on two fixtures: a plain local tab (no remote, no branch view) in History with a commit selected, which P56.3 loads, where it compares only the raw diff, the branches and `work_dir` (in History the App keeps the files of the mode it left, since `set_mode` touches only `self.history`, `crates/er-engine/src/app/state/mod.rs:4119`–`:4140`, and the content keeps none, so files, finding fields and line content differ there by intent) and writes in the expected raw diff, none, since `fetch_raw` refuses History, so a step that answers the content's raw with no guard (plant: no mode skip, no scope rule, no hash check) answers it and fails; and, comparing all of the raw diff, files, branches, `work_dir`, finding fields and line content, a tab whose raw diff is over the lazy threshold (200,000 bytes, `crates/er-engine/src/app/state/mod.rs:1385`–`:1387`), on both sides, whose finding sits in a file the content holds as a stub while the flag-off App has parsed it (`ensure_file_parsed_at`, as after the user opens it), both asserted first, where a line content read from the unparsed stub (plant) gives none and fails; the mode skip has its own test, on a local-branch tab whose branch is checked out nowhere, so its checkout root stays unset and the scope rule matches every mode (`mod.rs:2790`–`:2792`), shown in History: the expected answer is none, since `fetch_raw` refuses History, and a step without the mode skip (plant) answers the content's raw and fails; the non-empty `branch_diff_hash` check gets a fixture where the content's raw and `fetch_raw`'s answer differ, with a plant that drops the check, or the step plan states why no fixture can tell them apart; a late answer lands in the bucket the ask captured: an ask starts on tab A, then before the answer lands the registry's active tab moves to a tab B whose bucket differs (asserted first), or, separately, A switches mode to a view whose bucket differs from the captured one (asserted first; Branch to Unstaged on a plain tab), and the answer is on disk in A's captured bucket and A's `jobs` entry clears, while resolving the active tab at landing (plant, first case) or A's current content context at landing (plant, second case) writes it elsewhere and fails.
- **Fallback split (the plan):** P60.2a AI runs on `jobs`: the selection source, the prompt context, the two answer commands and the `ai_assist` reply; P60.2b triage, agent commands, logs, background tasks and the tick's App duties.
- Size: L.

Check: every done-when item exists and each planted break fails; flag-off unchanged; new commands satisfy er::command_shape and its allow-list only shrinks; source scans hold; History, Conflicts and Hidden keep the snapshot fallback until P56.3; each PR under 1,500.
